name: OCEN Settings
description: OAuth2 client credentials + signing key for the OCEN Registry (spec §6.4). Secrets use Frappe's encrypted Password fieldtype — never stored in plaintext config. Test against the OCEN sandbox before switching environment to Production.

fields.label: LA Participant ID
fields.description: This platform's own registered Loan Agent participant ID on the OCEN network.

fields.label: JWS Signing Key (PEM)
fields.description: Private key used to sign outbound requests per the OCEN request-signing spec.

fields.label: OCEN Registry Public Key (PEM)
fields.description: Not a secret — this is the OCEN Registry's public key, used to verify the detached JWS signature on inbound webhooks (spec §6.4). Confirm the exact header name/JWS format against real OCEN webhook docs before production use — this app assumes the X-Jws-Signature header carrying an RFC 7515 Appendix F detached-content JWS, matching the Account Aggregator/ReBIT convention OCEN's ecosystem generally follows, but this has not been confirmed against actual OCEN sandbox traffic.

fields.label: Cached Token (read-only, managed by the adapter)
LOS Site Connection (ADR 0005)
fields.description: Used by the webhook receivers to push status/offer updates back to the LOS site after processing an inbound OCEN webhook, and to authenticate inbound calls from LOS (ocen_connector.api.integration). Shared-secret auth, not Frappe's User api_key/api_secret — see utils/shared_auth.py's docstring for why.

fields.label: LOS Site Base URL
fields.description: e.g. http://localhost:8001 or the LOS site's real base URL.

fields.label: Integration Shared Secret
fields.description: Must match OCEN Integration Settings.integration_shared_secret on the LOS site exactly. Sent/checked via the X-Integration-Secret header in both directions.
